data.summary: Nyx Prime is a versatile Warframe with strong damage, crowd control, and support capabilities. Her survivability options are limited but effective when combined with her offensive abilities. She lacks stealth but excels in disrupting enemy formations and absorbing damage to enhance her own offense.
